entries.en: to believe firmly; firm, long-held trust
entries.notes: 西栏 no de cierto mente 若为否定语则与汉字「宿信」（久信）相抵，音写又有 co-sîn/Ljông-sîn 两读，语义未能定夺，暂从汉字取坚信义

entries.en: completely; fully; very much
all; every one; all without exception
entries.notes: 音写第二字声调标记污损难辨（T99）依例降级；汉字「尽皆」与西栏语义相合，释义按汉字定

entries.en: to the very end; completely; utterly
all day long; the whole day
all in all; altogether; in sum
entries.notes: 汉字第二字有疑标注（算/弄），音写 lui 与两候选皆不合、更近「归」之写法；西栏 junto monta（合计）与「总归」义相合

entries.en: a company of people; all are companions
all along; always; hitherto

entries.zh: 一体同罪；同担罪责，连坐
entries.en: guilty as one body; to share the same guilt (joint liability)
the whole household; all of one house
you all; all of you (plural address)
entries.notes: 汉字栏有疑（佮/泊），音写 lun 近 17 世纪文献「恁」（你们）之写法而第二音节 hio 未明，释义从西栏 todos vosotros 与音写推定

entries.en: to gather together; to assemble

entries.zh: 磨井（磨坊之井；字与西栏均难确证）
entries.en: mill well (uncertain reading)
entries.notes: 西栏 folba de molino 之 folba 难解，汉字「井」与音写 che 仅勉强相合，四栏未能互证

entries.zh: 磨喉（磨之喉口；喉与后同音，或为「磨后」）
entries.en: mill throat, or behind the mill (uncertain)
entries.notes: 「喉」与「后」音写同为 au 无从定夺，西栏同上条难解，照汉字与音写面值暂释

entries.zh: 垄井——西注谓淘米所用之水（字与音写未能互证，存疑）
entries.en: water for washing rice (per the Spanish note; character reading uncertain)
entries.notes: 西注 el agua con q. limpian arroz 清晰可读，但汉字「垄井」与音写 lang-che 无法与之互证，释义从西注

entries.zh: 垄喉——与上条同族（音写尾节 idy 疑为拉丁 idem「同前」省写）
entries.en: mill-related term as above (uncertain; 'idy' likely Latin id. = idem)
entries.notes: 与 13-15 同族而字义未明，idy 或为 idem 省写，西栏同 folba de molino 难解

entries.zh: 厌；厌倦，厌弃（据汉字暂释）
entries.en: to loathe; to be weary of (uncertain)
entries.notes: 音写 chio 与「厌」常见读音不合、疑字误（或为「憔/焦」），西栏 Folbo 未解，照汉字暂释

entries.en: tent; canopy; awning
entries.notes: 西栏 Foldilla 疑为 toldilla（小篷盖）之误辨，与「帐」义相合，但依赖推断故降为 medium

entries.en: sand; dust
entries.notes: 音写 Goa 与「沙」通行写法 Soa 不合、或为字母误辨或另有其字，西栏 Follo 未明，暂从汉字；与下条「沙鱼」连观或为同词简条
